contract: LH25 and LH25 STORE share a deep evergreen palette, mint primary actions, readable Vietnamese text and preserved alert semantics. STORE adapts the large-type, cinematic panel rhythm of Hallmark Ribbon without copying its assets. Existing Google users see one primary sign-in action; new users give LH25 data consent only when their account is created.

renderedEvidence.observation: STORE hero has green background, mint CTA and the group's annotated YOLO example in a cinematic monitor panel.
STORE headline and actions reflow to one column; horizontal scroll was tested and remains at x=0.
LH25 login uses evergreen background and one visible Google button; the legacy password form is collapsed.
LH25 login card and Google control remain readable at phone width.
In a simulated disabled-Google configuration, LH25 displays a message and the legacy-login disclosure.
At the unsupported 127.0.0.1 OAuth origin, STORE supplies a direct localhost sign-in link.

accessibility.evidence: Browser QA confirmed keyboard focus on the login-to-Store link shows a solid outline; the brand and STORE example have descriptive alt text; Google status is exposed with role=status.

responsive.evidence: At 390px, STORE document client and scroll widths are both 390px and attempted horizontal scroll remains x=0; LH25 login also fits 390px. Desktop screenshots were inspected at 1440x900.

loading.evidence: With Google configuration response delayed in an isolated browser test, LH25 displayed the pre-rendered 'Đang chuẩn bị đăng nhập Google…' status while keeping legacy credentials hidden.

empty.reason: These reviewed surfaces are the public marketing page and an unauthenticated login card, not a data collection or results view.

error.evidence: An isolated browser test simulated Google configuration disabled; LH25 showed the explanation and exposed the legacy-login disclosure, as captured in lh25-green-login-fallback.jpg.

partial.evidence: STORE content remained readable while Google sign-in was unavailable at 127.0.0.1 and showed a working localhost link; LH25 preserved a legacy fallback for a disabled Google configuration.

success.evidence: The real GSI button rendered in isolated localhost browser sessions; 22 Store/Google backend tests passed. A synthetic event test showed the dashboard remained open after a delayed stale /api/me 401. This does not claim a real Google popup sign-in was retested.

permission.evidence: An isolated test confirmed the unsupported OAuth origin shows localhost guidance. A mocked new-account 409 exposed LH25 terms only then; confirmation without checking sent no second request, and checking sent consent=true.

remainingVerification: A fresh real Google popup sign-in and completed Store purchase were not performed during this visual QA session.
